title: Separate nominal full control from incomplete robust-control interfaces
statement: For prior m=(1,Q,Q^2),a3=Q^3-Q, the transverse e=(0,Q*a3,-a3) has e.m=0 and |e|/|a|<=2/Q^3 while (a+e)_3=0. A k=e3 low mode can therefore remain unmixed under arbitrarily small relative polarisation error as Q grows; a first-coordinate-polarised cos(2pi*x3) datum is an exact decaying heat/shear flow. This refutes automatic robustness of that evacuation estimate, not the full robust NS/controller target or nominal BCA theorem. Root also gives a fixed finite orthogonal integer-pair directional cover: if two normalized coordinate components are>=1/4 choose their coordinate pair; otherwise a major component>sqrt(7/8) allows(e_i+e_j,e_i-e_j). For each direction some pair has both normalized |m.k| and |a.k|>=1/4, stable under rho0=1/1024 perturbations. Static phase conjugates ladder weights without changing central return amplitudes, and positive gain has a lower bound. Preventing return of low frequencies while composing such evacuations and paying nonlinear resource costs remains UNCONSTRUCTED.
